title: Polynomial-Time Computability of Marker Dropping
statement: The function on bit strings that processes each input bit with a two-state transducer, initially in state $0$, is polynomial-time computable: in state $0$ it emits nothing and moves to state $1$, while in state $1$ it emits the current bit and remains in state $1$.
